description: Look up one listed building by its NHLE list entry number (the 7-digit reference used in conveyancing and planning papers): name, grade, listing and last-amended dates, grid reference and official link. Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Covers listed buildings only; a number belonging to a scheduled monument, park, battlefield or wreck returns found: false. (cost: 1 credit)

list_entry.description: integer, required, NHLE list entry number, e.g. 1065833

name: listed_building_lookup
